description.value:
The following modifications are catalogued alphabetically; any listed prerequisite must already be met when you install one, and you may install a modification the same moment you meet its prerequisites.

  • Arakyd Vector (requires 5th level): +1 to tech attack rolls, rising to +2 at 11th level and +3 at 17th level.
  • Careful Subroutine: when you cast a power that forces other creatures to save, you may spend 1 additional tech point and choose a number of them up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one) who automatically succeed on their save. Only one Subroutine modification may be used on a given casting unless noted otherwise.
  • Cryo Amplifier: when a creature takes cold damage from a tech power you cast that requires an attack roll or save, it takes additional cold damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1).
  • Cryo Amplifier, Mk II (requires 7th level and Cryo Amplifier): when you deal damage with this amplifier, the creature gains 1 slowed level until the end of your next turn. Usable a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), all restored after a long rest.
  • Cryo Amplifier, Mk III (requires 13th level and Cryo Amplifier, Mk II): when you spend a use of Mk II and the creature fails its Constitution save, it becomes restrained until the start of your next turn instead.
  • Distant Subroutine: casting a power with a range of 5 feet or more, you may spend 1 additional tech point to double its range; alternatively, for a power with a range of touch, spend 1 additional tech point to set its range to 30 feet. Only one Subroutine modification may be used on a given casting unless noted otherwise.
  • Electrical Amplifier: when a creature takes lightning damage from a tech power you cast that requires an attack roll or save, it takes additional lightning damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1).
  • Electrical Amplifier, Mk II (requires 7th level and Electrical Amplifier): when you deal damage with this amplifier, the creature must succeed on a Constitution save or become shocked until the end of your next turn. Usable a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), all restored after a long rest.
  • Electrical Amplifier, Mk III (requires 13th level and Electrical Amplifier, Mk II): when you spend a use of Mk II and the creature fails its Constitution save, it becomes stunned until the start of your next turn instead.
  • Extended Subroutine: casting a power with a duration of 1 minute or longer, you may spend 1 additional tech point to double its duration, to a maximum of 24 hours. Only one Subroutine modification may be used on a given casting unless noted otherwise.
  • Evaluation Scanner: you can cast Analyze without spending tech points; using it on a tech focus reveals what tech powers, if any, are stored within it.
  • Explosive Amplifier: when a creature takes fire damage from a tech power you cast that requires an attack roll or save, it takes additional fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (rounded up, minimum +1).
  • Explosive Amplifier, Mk II (requires 7th level and Explosive Amplifier): when you deal damage with this amplifier, the creature becomes ignited (dealing damage equal to your techcasting ability modifier) until the start of its next turn. Usable a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), all restored after a long rest.
  • Explosive Amplifier, Mk III (requires 13th level and Explosive Amplifier, Mk II): a creature ignited by a use of Mk II that takes any fire damage while ignited has disadvantage on the next Dexterity save it makes before the start of its next turn.
  • Elemental Absorption: you can cast Absorb Energy once without spending tech points; you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
  • Elemental Ingenuity (requires 11th level): casting a power that deals fire, lightning, or cold damage, you may spend 1 additional tech point to swap its damage type among fire, lightning, or cold.
  • Elemental Ingenuity, Mk II (requires 13th level and Elemental Ingenuity): casting a power that deals acid, ion, poison, or sonic damage, you may spend 1 additional tech point to swap its damage type to fire, lightning, or cold.
  • Elemental Shielding (requires 11th level and a Cryo, Explosive, or Electrical Amplifier): you gain resistance to any damage type for which you have a matching amplifier modification installed.
  • Frailcasting Dynamics (requires 5th level): while using your wristpad as a tech focus, +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Strength or Constitution save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Hasty Translation: you can cast Translation Program once without spending tech points; you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
  • Heightened Subroutine (requires 5th level): casting a power that forces a saving throw, you may spend 2 additional tech points to give one target disadvantage on its first save against the power. Only one Subroutine modification may be used on a given casting unless noted otherwise.
  • Improved Subroutine: rolling damage for a power, you may spend 1 additional tech point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), and you must use the new rolls. This can be used even if you've already used a different Subroutine modification on the same casting.
  • Lingering Subroutine (requires 5th level): casting a power that requires concentration, you may spend 3 additional tech points; if you then lose concentration on it, the power doesn't end until the end of your next turn. Only one Subroutine modification may be used on a given casting unless noted otherwise.
  • Long Range Comms (requires 5th level): you can cast Sending at a creature whose frequency is registered on your wristpad without spending tech points; a willing creature can register its frequency with an action, and your device can hold a number of frequencies equal to your proficiency bonus, removable as an action.
  • Pinpoint Subroutine: casting a power that forces creatures in an area to save, you may instead spend 1 tech point and make a ranged tech attack against a single target within the power's range; a hit resolves as though the target failed its save. Only one Subroutine modification may be used on a given casting unless noted otherwise.
  • Quickened Subroutine (requires 5th level): casting a power with a casting time of 1 action, you may spend 2 additional tech points to change its casting time to 1 bonus action for that casting. Only one Subroutine modification may be used on a given casting unless noted otherwise.
  • Refocused Subroutine (requires 5th level): forced to make a Constitution save to maintain concentration, you may use your reaction and spend 2 tech points to automatically succeed. This can be used even if you've already used a different Subroutine modification on the same casting.
  • Rendcasting Dynamics (requires 5th level): while using your wristpad as a tech focus, +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Dexterity or Intelligence save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Seeking Subroutine (requires 5th level): missing with a tech power that calls for an attack roll, you may spend 2 tech points to reroll the attack, using the new result. This can be used even if you've already used a different Subroutine modification on the same casting.
  • Thermodynamic Conservation: once per round when you take cold, fire, or lightning damage from a force or tech power, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice the power's level (minimum one) to help absorb it, lasting until the end of your next turn; if the matching amplifier's Mk II upgrade is installed, this amount increases by your Intelligence modifier (minimum one).
  • Twinned Subroutine (requires 5th level): casting a power that has only a single target and no range of self, you may spend additional tech points equal to the power's level (or 1 if it's at-will) to give it a second target within range. Only one Subroutine modification may be used on a given casting unless noted otherwise.
  • Voltaic Screen: you can cast Voltaic Shielding once without spending tech points; you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
  • Withercasting Dynamics (requires 5th level): while using your wristpad as a tech focus, +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Wisdom or Charisma save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
